original: atra udayamabhivṛddhi prāpto raktamaṇḍalo’anuraktaprajaḥ rājā nṛpatiḥ mṛdulaiḥ karaiḥ grāhyadhanaiḥ lokahṛdayaṃ harati āvarjayatīti prākaraṇikārthaḥ | udayagirimārūḍhaḥ aruṇamaṇḍalo rājā candraḥ mṛdu kiraṇair janahṛdayamākapatīti aprākaraṇikārthaḥ | śliṣṭapadānāṃ prakṛtā prakṛtārthagocaratvātprakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣaḥ |

original: idamatrāvadheyam “sarvado mādhavaḥ”, “yo’gaṃgām”, “iśi hitasaktinā” ityādau paraspara vilakṣaṇa padabhagamapekṣya nānārthabodhanāta sabhaśleṣaḥ| “abjakīlālavāhinīpati” prabhṛtiṣu padeṣu tāmā padabhaḍamanapekṣyaiva nānārthabodhanād abhaṅgaśleṣaḥ iti prakārāntareṇāti śleṣasya dvaividhyam |
analyzed: idam atra avadheyam sarva daḥ mādhavaḥ yogaṃgām iśi hita saktinā ityādau paraspara abja kīlāla vāhinīpati prabhṛtiṣu padeṣu pada bhaḍam an apekṣya eva nānā artha bodhanāt abhaṅga śleṣaḥ iti prakāra antareṇa ati śleṣasya dvaividhyam

original: prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣe aprakṛtārthasya vyaṅgayatvamiti keṣāṃcinmatam | anye tu tasyāpi vācyatvamaṅgīkṛtya prakṛtāprakṛtayorabhedaḥ sādṛśyaṃ vā vyaṅgayamiti vadanti | atra prathamamate prakṛtāprakṛtaśleṣo nodāhartavyaḥ | dvitīyamate śabdaśaktimūlavastudhvanir nodāhartavyaḥ |
analyzed: prakṛta aprakṛta śleṣe aprakṛta arthasya vyaṅgaya tvam iti keṣāṃcid matam anye tu tasya api vācya tvam aṅgīkṛtya prakṛta aprakṛtayoḥ abhedaḥ sādṛśyam vā vyaṅgayam iti vadanti atra prathama mate prakṛta aprakṛta śleṣaḥ na udāhartavyaḥ dvitīya mate śabda śakti mūla vastu dhvaniḥ na udāhartavyaḥ

original: atra sārvabhauma vinā anya śaṃdra prabhu na prārthaye ityabhimānaśālino vṛttāntasya prastutasya pratyāyanārtha tatsadṛśacātakavṛttānto varṇita iti lakṣaṇasaṅgatiḥ|

original: aprastutena prastutāvagatiḥ prastutāprastutayoḥ saṃbandhe sati bhavati | saṃvandhaśca sārūpyaṃ, sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ, kāryakāraṇabhāvā vā saṃbhavati | “ekaḥ kṛtī” ityādi sārūpyanibandhanāyāḥ aprastutapraśaṃsāyā udāharaṇam| sāmānyaviśeṣabhāve sāmānyādviśeṣasya, viśeṣātsāmānyasya vā avagatiriti dvaividhyam |

original: evaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāve’pi kāryātkāraṇasya, kāraṇāt kāryasya vā avagatiriti dvaividhyam | eteṣāṃ caturṇā udāharaṇāni anubandhe draṣṭavyāni |
